'''Nomar Organa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who was the youngest son of the third brother of the [[Count/Legends|Count]] of [[House of Organa/Legends|Organa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
As a young boy he was discovered to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and as such given to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to be [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in their ways. Despite rules against maintaining attachment to family, Organa was able to return to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. In [[3666 BBY]] he met and fell in love with one of the daughters of [[House Rist]], [[Rehanna Rist|Rehanna]]. Their relationship was seen in a positive light by the two houses who negotiated an alliance over their [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]]. The Jedi Order, however, did not approve when the news reached them and refused to engage a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in local [[Politics/Legends|politics]]. On their order, Organa broke off his marriage and returned to serve the Order.

Twenty-three years later, during the [[Alderaan Civil War]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] named [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] arrived on Alderaan searching for an artifact of [[Tulak Hord]]. The artifact was kept sealed within the [[Elysium]] and Nomar's key is required to access it. With the aid of [[Elana Thul]], Kallig discovered the holorecording of Organa breaking off his engagement in the archives of [[House Alde]]. Kallig then confronted Rehanna in House Rist's fortress, coercing her into arranging to meet with Organa in the old [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] tunnels. Once confronted, the Jedi Master proved no match against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and was [[Death/Legends|killed]].

===Legacy===
While dreamwalking on [[Voss]] to subdue [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghosts]] bound to Kallig via the [[Force walk]], the ghost of [[Kalatosh Zavros]] took the form of Nomar Organa in an attempt to kill Kallig.<ref name="TOR2">{{TORcite|type=class|[[Darth Nox|Sith Inquisitor]]|The Ritual|[[Voss]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Nomar Organa is voiced by [[Yuri Lowenthal]]. The player can choose to either outright kill Nomar Organa (dark side dialogue) or coerce Rehanna beforehand (light side dialogue) into trying to rekindle their relationship. If the latter is chosen, Nomar and his Padawans will be waiting in front of the Elysium to stop Kallig from taking the artifact either way.
